name: warming up in lunge (seven)
description: Lunge warm-up, part 7: add a bent-arm chest rotation to a forearm-supported low lunge.
instructions: Step one foot forward outside your hands and extend the rear leg back into a low lunge.
Place the forearm nearest the front foot on the floor or a block for support.
Place your free hand behind your head and gently rotate your chest open toward that elbow.
Return to center slowly, then switch sides.
